title: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: Keep Screen AwakeIngredients3largeeggs1/8teaspoonkosher salt(see note)2tablespoons(1ounce;30ml)milk(optional)1/2tablespoon(1/4ounce;8g)unsalted butterFreshlyground black or white pepper
3largeeggs1/8teaspoonkosher salt(see note)2tablespoons(1ounce;30ml)milk(optional)1/2tablespoon(1/4ounce;8g)unsalted butterFreshlyground black or white pepper

steps.text: Directions In a small bowl, beat eggs with salt and milk (if using). In a nonstick skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat until foamy. Add eggs and cook, stirring and scrambling gently with a silicone spatula, until large, fluffy curds form and eggs are fully cooked through, about 3 minutes. Season with pepper and serve. Special Equipment Nonstick skillet , silicone spatula Notes We like to season our eggs with salt at about 1% of their weight, or about 1.5g for 3 large eggs (though we rarely actually measure it out in practice). Just note that not only do different eaters have different salt-level preferences, but the volume of a given weight of salt itself will vary dramatically by brand, so season at your own discretion.
